title: Queensland General Long Service Leave
audience_purpose: Advisory operator assistance about the scope and limits of Queensland General Long Service Leave.
advisory_notice: Advisory information only; not legal advice.
scope_statement: This pack covers Queensland General Long Service Leave under the Queensland Industrial Relations Act 2016 and related Queensland Government explanatory material, subject to the source scope and application rules.
excluded_scope: QLeave external portable-scheme operations are excluded. Do not answer registration, levy, return, claim, reimbursement, payment, or other QLeave operational procedure questions from this pack.

sources.title: Industrial Relations Act 2016 (Qld)
sources.citation_locator: Chapter 2, Part 3, Division 9, ss 93-105; especially ss 93, 95, 97, 98, 103 and 105

facts.claim: Queensland General Long Service Leave is the subject of this pack where the cited Queensland framework applies; QLeave portable-scheme operations are outside the pack.
facts.plain_language_explanation: Use this pack for the Queensland General LSL framework and its cited explanations. It is not a QLeave operations guide.
facts.scope: Queensland General LSL information for operator explanation.
facts.limits_exclusions: Application can depend on the federal system, industrial instruments, worker circumstances and statutory exceptions; this fact does not decide eligibility.

facts.claim: For an employee other than a seasonal employee, the cited Act provides 8.6667 weeks of long service leave after 10 years continuous service, with further proportional entitlement after a further 5 years.
facts.plain_language_explanation: The general overview is 8.6667 weeks after 10 years, then a proportional further amount after another 5 years, subject to the Act and applicable instruments.
facts.scope: The general non-seasonal employee provision described by section 95 and the Queensland Government guide.
facts.limits_exclusions: This is not an individual entitlement result and does not resolve service history, industrial instruments, federal coverage or exceptions.

facts.claim: The cited framework addresses proportionate payment after at least 7 years on termination subject to stated conditions, and treats continuous service and particular absences according to statutory rules.
facts.plain_language_explanation: A 7-year pro-rata termination outcome is conditional, and continuous service must be assessed against the Act and the facts rather than assumed from a simple elapsed-time total.
facts.scope: High-level explanation of the cited termination and continuity rules.
facts.limits_exclusions: The pack does not decide a disputed termination reason, reconstruct service, or calculate payment.

facts.claim: The cited material explains that taking and payment depend on the applicable statutory provisions, rate rules and circumstances; the pack is not a payroll valuation engine.
facts.plain_language_explanation: The sources provide general guidance about taking leave and payment rates, but Minerva must not turn that guidance into a live payroll or entitlement calculation.
facts.limits_exclusions: No employee rate, hours, service dates, leave balance, payment, payslip or pay-run data may be supplied or inferred in this slice.

facts.claim: This publication is a cited knowledge pack, not a service-history calculator, entitlement engine, payroll valuation engine, live policy result, or QLeave operational implementation.
facts.plain_language_explanation: Minerva can explain the reviewed facts and their limits, but it cannot resolve a live worker case or execute a Leave operation from this pack.
facts.scope: Governed use boundary for every answer and proposal in this slice.
facts.limits_exclusions: Specialist advice is appropriate when the sources do not determine the answer; production authentication, tenant isolation and Workforce Platform integration are not established here.
